title: Ecotone
definition: An ecotone is a transitional area of vegetation between two different plant communities, such as forest and grassland, characterized by a high degree of species diversity and density.
importanceInUpsc: Ecotones are critical for understanding biodiversity hotspots, climate change impacts, and ecological sensitivity, frequently appearing in Prelims (Environment/Ecology) and Mains (GS Paper III).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Ecotone.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
